name: Tokyo Twilight Busters ~Kindan no Ikenie Teito Jigokuhen~
original_name: 東京トワイライトバスターズ ～禁断の生贄帝都地獄変～
source:
1923, Tokyo – The Taishou era – Whilst studying abroad in England, Sho Kusanagi receives news that his father - Professor Takuma Kusanagi of the Imperial University - has been reported missing. Sho returns to Japan to uncover the truth behind his father’s disappearance, and is quickly involved with a series of mysterious incidents that have appeared in the capital.

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/tokyo/tokyo1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
translation:
1923年，东京——大正时代——草薙翔在英国留学时，收到父亲失踪的消息。父亲草薙拓真是帝国大学教授。翔回到日本，试图揭开父亲失踪的真相，很快便卷入首都接连发生的一系列神秘事件。

[来源：[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/tokyo/tokyo1.html]Japan Adventure Attack[/url]]
